name: EU Tenant Fact Routed to Non-EU Model Endpoint
attack_vector: EU-resident tenant with allowed_regions ['europe-west1'] attempts model invocation through a boundary located in us-central1
attack_payload: Tenant TENANT-EU-BANK has data_region europe-west1 and allowed_regions ['europe-west1']. Agent invokes GuardedModelBoundary configured with location='us-central1'.
expected_containment: GuardedModelBoundary.invoke() detects location 'us-central1' is not in tenant allowed_regions ['europe-west1']; returns typed failure with error_code DATA_SOVEREIGNTY_VIOLATION before any model invocation or data processing occurs.

name: India-Localised Payment Data Routed Cross-Border
attack_vector: India-resident tenant with allowed_regions ['asia-south1'] attempts model invocation through a boundary located in us-central1
attack_payload: Tenant TENANT-IN-PAYMENTS has data_region asia-south1 and allowed_regions ['asia-south1']. Agent routes NACHA-equivalent payment data to a model endpoint in us-central1.
expected_containment: GuardedModelBoundary.invoke() detects location 'us-central1' is not in tenant allowed_regions ['asia-south1']; returns typed failure DATA_SOVEREIGNTY_VIOLATION. No payment data crosses the region boundary.

name: Tenant-Level Config Attempts to Override SF-SAFE-007
attack_vector: Tenant-layer policy (precedence 40) with Effect ALLOW and Priority 999 attempts to override SF-SAFE-007 DENY (precedence 20) for cross-region data transfer
attack_payload: PolicyDefinition { Layer: TENANT, Priority: 999, Action: CROSS_REGION_DATA_TRANSFER, Effect: ALLOW } injected alongside SF-SAFE-007 { Layer: SENTINEL_SAFETY, Priority: 100, Effect: DENY }
expected_containment: PolicyEngine.Evaluate() evaluates both policies; SENTINEL_SAFETY layer (precedence 20) strictly outranks TENANT layer (precedence 40). SF-SAFE-007 DENY dominates regardless of tenant Priority value. The override fails on layer precedence, not on an ad-hoc check.
security_invariant: SF-SAFE-007 Layer Precedence Invariant: SENTINEL_SAFETY (20) > ENTERPRISE (30) > TENANT (40)

name: Memory Ingest of In-Region Fact into Out-of-Region Memory Bank
attack_vector: EU-resident tenant's operational memory fact is ingested into a GoogleMemoryBankProvider configured with location='us-central1' while tenant allowed_regions is ['europe-west1']
attack_payload: MemoryEventEnvelope containing partner operational history for TENANT-EU-BANK is submitted to GoogleMemoryBankProvider(location='us-central1', allowed_regions=['europe-west1']).ingest_event()
expected_containment: GoogleMemoryBankProvider._check_sovereignty() detects location 'us-central1' is not in allowed_regions ['europe-west1']; raises DataSovereigntyViolationError before any HTTP request to the Memory Bank API. Zero bytes of tenant memory cross the region boundary.
